MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH — TERMLY EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.

2. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. pascal (Pa)

3. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Reproduction? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Reproduction.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Reproduction.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Reproduction.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Reproduction.

5. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 37 °C

6. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Only carbon dioxide

7. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.

9. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Milk souring
   D. Paper burning to ash

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Record keeping in aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Record keeping in aquaculture.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Record keeping in aquaculture.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Record keeping in aquaculture.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Record keeping in aquaculture.

11. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Overgrazing continuously

12. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conservation of marine and freshwater environments? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish feeds and feeding? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish feeds and feeding.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish feeds and feeding.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish feeds and feeding.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish feeds and feeding.

15. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Producers
   D. Primary consumers only

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Fish Reproduction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Fish Ecology and Ecosystems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Ornamental Fish culture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Fish feeds and feeding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
